audit.whatIsWrong: Page repeatedly calls Naafiri's gap-closer 'W' ('W dive', 'suppresses your W dash', 'W The Hunt'). Also spikes[0] said 'his W Call of the Void slow' — Call of the Void is Malzahar's Q and it silences; W is Void Swarm.
audit.why: Kit file is authority on slots and effects. His Q (flat 6s CD) silence denies her dash/escape for its duration; his R suppresses through her dive.
